_about: Narration lines for the long-form compilations. clip:* lines are shared by every compilation that uses the clip (placed at chapter start + 0.6 s); intro:* replaces the first clip's line in that video; close is said on the end card. commercial-idle-forklift has a second line at chapter + 17.9 s. Voice Justin Case (DtQLDxHbTiQTpVVanTy1), eleven_v4.

clip.ai-lists-it: Selling equipment? Add one photo. The AI reads it and fills in the details. You check it, then post.
clip.find-it-nearby: Need equipment? Find it nearby. Thirty-three categories, all local. Tap a listing, ask the seller, and pick it up close by.
clip.free-to-list: Buyers make offers right in the app, and they pay you directly. All of it.
clip.message-the-seller: Have a question? Message the seller. Pickup tips are built in. Set a time and see it run.
clip.save-a-search: Looking for something? Save the search. We'll tell you when it's listed, right on your phone.
clip.every-category: Trucks, trailers, generators, forklifts, shop tools, restaurant gear. Thirty-three categories, and every one is free to list.
clip.make-an-offer: See something you like? Make an offer. If the seller counters, accept in one tap, then set up pickup.
clip.dealer-storefront: Selling a lot of units? Get a storefront. All your inventory in one place, and buyers can search it.
clip.follow-a-seller: Like what a seller has? Open their profile and tap Follow. You get an alert when they post.
clip.list-4-boosted-free: Three listings up? Post a fourth. The AI fills it in, you set the price, and all four get boosted free for fourteen days.
clip.already-on-craigslist: Already on Craigslist? Don't type it again. Paste your post link and it all fills in. Got a free boost? Use it as you publish.
clip.see-what-buyers-want: See what buyers search for near you, including the searches that found nothing. Got one of those listed? Use a Dealer boost.
clip.snap-it-list-it: Got a compressor to sell? Add one photo. The AI reads it and fills in the details. You check it, then post.
clip.spare-part: The spare motor that fits nothing you own. One photo, the AI fills in the details, you fix anything, set your price, and post. Live, free.
clip.invite-a-seller: Know someone with idle gear? Send them your invite. They sign up with your code, and you both get a free seven-day boost.
clip.show-the-cold-start: Buyers will ask if it starts anyway. Add a video of the cold start, set your price, and post. Free to list.
clip.sold-it-list-the-next: Sold it? Mark it in one tap. Got another one sitting there? One photo, and it's listed free. No cut of the sale.
clip.that-trailer-next-season: The trailer you swore you'd use next season. One photo, the AI fills in the details, even the specs. Set your price, post, and it's live. Free.
clip.forklift-sitting-there: The forklift that's been sitting there. One photo, the AI fills in power, mast and tires. Set your price, post, and your forklift is live. Free.
clip.surplus-parts-cash-flow: A surplus part on the shelf. Snap it, and the AI reads the nameplate, part number and specs. Buyers search by part number. Set a price and post.
clip.surplus-parts-labels: Spare cylinders on a pallet. Snap the label, the AI reads the part number and specs, and buyers find it by part number. Listed free.
clip.micrometer-set-small-tools: A micrometer set you don't use. Snap the case with the lid open. The AI reads the brand, sizes and condition. Set your price and post.
clip.boring-bars-tooling: Boring bars the new lathe doesn't take. Snap them, numbers up. The AI reads the shank size and condition, and buyers search by tooling. Listed free.
clip.chop-saw-small-tools: A spare chop saw. Snap it where it sits. The AI fills in brand, model and condition, and buyers nearby can find it. Listed free.
clip.condenser-changeout: The condenser from a changeout. Snap the data plate side. The AI reads brand and tonnage, and buyers search by tonnage. Listed free.
clip.pressure-washer-replaced: The pressure washer you replaced. Snap it, hose and all. The AI reads the badge, brand and PSI. Set your price and post.
clip.air-mover-fleet: Extra air movers. Snap one at floor level. The AI fills in brand, model and condition, and buyers nearby find it. Listed free.
clip.spare-truck-wheel: A spare wheel from a truck you sold. Snap the lip and lugs. The AI fills in the size and lug count. Set your price and post.
clip.leftover-anchor-adhesive: Leftover anchor adhesive. Snap the cartridges, labels up. The AI reads the brand and product, and buyers search by product. Listed free.
clip.part-tag-scan: A cylinder with its tag still on. Snap it, tag in frame. The AI reads brand, model and part number straight off the label. Set your price and post.
clip.commercial-idle-forklift: Add one photo and the AI fills it in, specs included. You check them, set your price, and list it free. It's live.
clip.commercial-idle-forklift-2: Six miles away, a buyer searches. The specs check out, and an offer comes in. Accept in a tap, set the pickup. No cut of the sale.
clip.parts-donor-thumb: The thumb off the excavator you sold. Snap it, and the AI writes the title and category. Pulled parts sell with no part number. Set a price and post. Cash, not scrap.
clip.parts-bin-lot: The parts bin you keep meaning to sort. Snap it and sell it as one lot; the buyer sorts it. Set your price and post. Shelf space back.
clip.plumbing-part-label: One brass fitting. Snap it with the label in frame. The AI reads the size and connection off the label: a three-quarter inch corp stop. Set a price and post.
clip.leftover-fittings-lot: Fittings left over from three jobs, new in the package. Snap the pile and sell it as one lot. Set your price and post. Van space back.
clip.control-panel-pulled: A control panel pulled on a changeout. One photo, and the AI writes the title and files it under Electrical.
clip.drilling-rig-parked: A drilling rig parked since the last well. Snap it, mast up or down, and the AI files it under Drilling and Boring.
clip.pressure-washer-1000-psi: The old pressure washer that stayed after the upgrade. One photo, no typing, listed free.
clip.building-things-concrete-mixer: Done building things this season? The mixer stays in the yard. Snap it, the AI fills in the title and category, tap the price, done.
clip.bluecollar-shelf-parts: The parts already on your shelf. Snap one fitting, tap Parts and Other, and the AI reads the size off the nut. Listed free.
